g.text: Unnormalized orders duplicate customer data per row -- normalized moves it to exactly one row
order_id=1 customer=Alice address=123 Elm St item=Book
order_id=2 customer=Alice address=123 Elm St item=Pen
order_id=3 customer=Alice address=123 Elm St item=Mug
same address, copied into all 3 rows
(and every other row for this customer)
Alice moves. Updating "her address" now means updating
N rows correctly. Miss one -> two addresses for the same
customer, both stored as true. That's the update anomaly.
The address exists in exactly one row.
Update it once; every order referencing
